newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Airbus says it outsells Boeing in United States.
newsitem.headline: Airbus says it outsells Boeing in United States.

text.p: European aerospace consortium Airbus Industrie is outperforming Boeing Co. on its home turf, Jonathan Schofield, Airbus chief for North America, said Tuesday.
"It's an arrogant statement, but I believe we're outselling Boeing this year in North America," said Schofield, chairman and chief executive of Airbus Industrie of North America.
Schofield, speaking at a meeting of the European Aviation Club, did not offer any figures to back up his view.
"I feel quite well accepted and as long as we're selling at the rate we're selling at in North America, I consider the company extremely successful," he said.
Schofield said he was not worried by an agreement earlier this month between Boeing and McDonnell Douglas Corp. to collaborate on future Boeing wide-body commercial airplane programmes.
